games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
games.note: Crashes at about 75% of loading with "mutex lock failed: Cannot allocate memory" on 1.002.000, even with no mods and default settings; a fix is proposed in pull request #210 and not yet in a release. Separately, 1.003.000 fixed a startup crash with UltraCam (tested on TOTK 1.1.1 to the menu) and adds a per-game memory setting of up to 8 GiB for demanding mods.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
games.note: Runs, with low frame rates in places. With UltraCam it restarted at "Starting the Game" on 1.000.100; 1.003.000 fixed a similar UltraCam crash in Tears of the Kingdom and adds up to 8 GiB of memory per game, so it's worth retrying. Simplified Chinese text fell back to English with ShadowMountPlus 1.7beta4; a fix is on the way upstream.

games.name: Luigi's Mansion 3
games.note: Frame rates collapse and the game crashes on Floor 10 (Tomb Suites) on 1.002.000 and 1.003.000, with or without mods (v1.4.0). An earlier report on 1.001.000 said it plays well, and an early version ran out of graphics memory at the opening scene.

games.name: Monster Hunter Generations Ultimate
games.note: Played well (v1.5.0) on 1.001.000. A player on issue #260 reports the same frame-rate drop as Kirby and the Forgotten Land on newer versions, which pull request #275 addresses.

games.name: Metroid Prime 4

games.name: Ori and the Blind Forest: Definitive Edition
games.note: Blinking layers and dark patches were reported fixed in 1.005.000 and the issue was closed; another player still sees them in handheld mode.

games.name: The Stretchers

games.name: Achilles: Survivor
games.note: Plays with glitches (v1.0.2).

games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.note: On 1.005.000 it starts with its update and the Booster Course DLC beside it. With a mods folder in its game folder it doesn't start, even with the mod switched off: the folder's mods were also applied to the DLC. Pull request #288 fixes that, and the reporter confirmed it boots with that build; it isn't in a release yet. Until then, keep its mods in mods/0100152000022000/ instead. Earlier, on 1.000.110, it crashed with the CTGDX mod (game v3.0.3).
